summary: Russia launched a massive wave of jet-powered UAVs and cruise missiles across at least 12 Ukrainian regions, killing civilians in Kyiv, Kharkiv, and Fastiv districts while striking energy infrastructure in Ternopil and Odesa. Ukrainian forces simultaneously struck Russian ammunition depots, personnel concentrations, and an oil pumping station in Tambov region. The U.S. acknowledged delays in military aid delivery and unfulfilled air defense agreements, as South Korea recalled diplomats citing security risks.
key_points: Russia launched over 30 Shahed/Geran drones and 7 Banderyol cruise missiles targeting 12+ Ukrainian regions overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77291, @mon1tor_ua/77317, @eRadarrua/124825)
Russian strikes killed three and injured six in Obukhiv district (Kyiv region), injured five in Izium (Kharkiv), and hit energy infrastructure in Ternopil and Odesa. (Source: @UkraineNow/84783)
Russian drone attack on Kyiv-Odesa highway in Fastiv district killed three, injured four, and burned vehicles. (Source: @UkraineNow/84785)
Russian strike on central park in Nova Vodolaha (Kharkiv) killed an infant and two women, injured 14 including seven children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84771)

Ukrainian forces destroyed Russian ammo depots in Hryntal and Ternove (Donetsk), a materiel depot near Pelahiivka (Donetsk), and struck personnel in Svobodne, Volodymyrivka (Donetsk) and Naberezhne (Zaporizhzhia). (Source: @UkraineNow/84770)
Ukrainian drones attacked Russia's Nikolskaya oil pumping station in Tambov region, a key Druzhba pipeline node. (Source: @UkraineNow/84782)
U.S. defense ministry delayed critical military aid; political agreements on air defense systems unfulfilled at working level. (Source: @UkraineNow/84774)
South Korea recalled diplomats from Ukraine citing security risks from Russian air attacks and lack of dispute resolution. (Source: @UkraineNow/84789)

points: Ukrainian forces struck Russian artillery and UAV crew positions near Lyman Pershyi in Kharkiv region, destroyed ammunition depots in Hryntal and Ternove (Donetsk), a materiel depot near Pelahiivka (Donetsk), and personnel concentrations in Svobodne, Volodymyrivka (Donetsk) and Naberezhne (Zaporizhzhia). (Source: @UkraineNow/84770)

Ukrainian drones attacked the Nikolskaya oil pumping station in Russia's Tambov region near Michurinsk, a key node on the Druzhba pipeline transporting diesel, gasoline, jet fuel, and fuel oil. (Source: @UkraineNow/84782)
President Zelenskyy reported U.S. defense ministry delays in supplying critical resources and unfulfilled political agreements on air defense systems at the working level. (Source: @UkraineNow/84774)
Lieutenant Colonel Oleksandr Zhybrov was posthumously awarded the Hero of Ukraine title for his 2022 Su-25 attack halting an enemy column and mentoring future aces. (Source: @kpszsu/88793)

South Korea recalled diplomats from Ukraine citing lack of positive steps on dispute resolution and persistent Russian air attack risks, following Zelenskyy's transfer of captured North Korean soldiers. (Source: @UkraineNow/84789)
Volunteers raised funds for 1,350 FPV drones on optical fiber for HUR MOU units operating on the Zaporizhzhia front. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77322)

Russian forces launched at least 30 Shahed-136/Geran-2 drones and 7 Banderyol cruise missiles from multiple directions including Orel (6 groups), Donetsk (4 groups), Bryansk, Crimea, and occupied Ukrainian territories targeting nationwide. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77291, @mon1tor_ua/77317, @eRadarrua/124825)
A Russian strike on an enterprise in Obukhiv district, Kyiv region, killed three and injured six; another strike on Izium, Kharkiv region, injured five. (Source: @UkraineNow/84783)
Russian attacks hit energy infrastructure in Ternopil and Odesa regions, and a morning strike on Dnipro caused injuries. (Source: @UkraineNow/84783)
A Russian drone attack on the Kyiv-Odesa highway in Fastiv district killed three, injured four, and set vehicles ablaze, restricting traffic. (Source: @UkraineNow/84785)
Russian forces struck a central park in Nova Vodolaha, Kharkiv region, killing an infant and two women, injuring at least 14 including seven children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84771)
Russian military satellite Cosmos-2612 approached the Ukrainian-used ICEYE-X36 satellite within 200 meters, assessed as potential hostile intent. (Source: @UkraineNow/84778)
Ukrainian strikes destroyed Russian ammunition depots in Hryntal and Ternove (Donetsk region) and a materiel depot near Pelahiivka (Donetsk region). (Source: @UkraineNow/84770)
Ukrainian forces targeted Russian personnel concentrations in Svobodne and Volodymyrivka (Donetsk region) and Naberezhne (Zaporizhzhia region). (Source: @UkraineNow/84770)
Russian forces launched four groups of reactive UAVs from Donetsk region toward Ukrainian targets. (Source: @eRadarrua/124825)
Russian cruise missiles (Banderyol) launched from Kharkiv region struck Dnipro, Pavlohrad, and Kamianske in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77317)

Russian ballistic missile threat detected from northeastern direction; multiple reactive UAV groups launched from Chernihiv and Kyiv regions toward northern Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/124715, @eRadarrua/124716, @eRadarrua/124802)

Russian Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk region targeted Chernihiv region; reactive Shaheds from Chernihiv region targeted Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77291, @mon1tor_ua/77327)
Ukrainian forces struck Russian artillery and UAV crew positions near Lyman Pershyi in Kharkiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84770)
Russian strike on central park in Nova Vodolaha, Kharkiv region, caused civilian casualties including children. (Source: @UkraineNow/84771)
Russian reactive Shaheds launched from Kherson region and Black Sea waters targeted Mykolaiv region (Bashynskyi and Mykolaivskyi districts). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77291)
Russian Geran-5 missile launched from Crimea targeted Black Sea waters. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77313)
Ukrainian drone attack hit Nikolskaya oil pumping station in Russia's Tambov region, a key Druzhba pipeline node. (Source: @UkraineNow/84782)
Russian strikes damaged energy infrastructure in Odesa region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84783)
